title: Tesla, Inc. Q2 2026 Form 10-Q
excerpt: Q2 revenue was USD 28.236 billion, operating income was USD 398 million, and cash plus short-term investments was USD 43.524 billion at June 30, 2026.
summary: The current filing supports a sum-of-parts review using annualized automotive and services revenue, energy revenue, diluted shares, net cash, capital intensity and bounded AI-enabled option value.
